none: PAS NLM-C0D0A4: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17, possibly Lyon mint. Obverse description: Bust probably diademed, draped and cuirassed right; large eye. Obverse inscription: CO[---]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; the standard bears a Chi Rho on its square flag. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: PLG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 13.3mm, Weight: 1.07gms, die axis: 12
